target: Pinned Primer React Popover open-state data attributes, outside-click and Escape hook wiring limitations
observed_behavior: The pinned Popover root forwards an open prop into PopoverContext (open ?? false) and sets data-open only when open is truthy, data-relative when relative is truthy, and data-caret with default 'top'. Popover.Content obtains the context open state, uses a stable empty ignore-click-ref array by default, and passes a supplied onClickOutside or a no-op fallback into imported useOnOutsideClick together with divRef. It invokes useOnEscapePress with a callback that calls onEscape(event) and event.preventDefault() only when open is truthy and onEscape exists. The component renders content markup with data-width and data-height defaults. These are controlled-state and hook-callback statements, not observed dismissal.
